name: meeting-agent
description: AI notetaker that joins Microsoft Teams and Google Meet calls, understands Hindi, Telugu, English and mixed speech, and emails an English report card: decisions, action items, MOM, participation, mentions and attendance. Telegram check-in decides whether the bot joins.

paragraphs: A bot that joins your meeting as a visible participant, listens in Hindi, Telugu, English or any mix of them, and sends an English report card when the call ends: summary, decisions, action items with owners, who said what. On top of that it produces Minutes of Meeting in the Teams notes style (copy to email, Word or PDF), a searchable transcript with audio playback, chapters, per-person participation, name mentions with timestamps, a meeting score and a downloadable attendance sheet. The minutes check the agenda you typed, list questions nobody answered, and change shape for a daily status…

Project Story joins related meetings (same title or same meeting link) into one page: what changed between meetings ("SharePoint: excluded on 3 Sep, used for document lookup on 8 Oct"), what is still open and for how long, a timeline, and a status update ready to paste. After any meeting, one click drafts the next meeting's agenda from what is still open and schedules it. Messages and links typed in the meeting chat are kept with the report, and any report can be shared as a private read-only link.

A chatbot sits in the corner of every page. Ask it anything about a meeting, or about all of them, by typing or by voice, in English, Hinglish, Hindi or Telugu. It answers with the exact transcript lines as proof, suggests the next question, and can do things for you (tick or add a task, remind its owner, write the follow-up email, rename, share, change the meeting type or agenda, send the bot) after you press Confirm.

requirements.text: Open meeting-agent-alpha.vercel.app and sign in with email or Google.

Locally you can sign in with Continue on this computer, the database is a SQLite file, the background check runs in a thread, and reports are written by Llama 3.1 through Ollama unless GEMINIAPIKEY is set.
